notes:
Lead source: inbound form from docs-search landing page. Company builds a mid-market knowledge base product aimed at SMBs; primary feature is smart search across uploaded docs and customer support threads.

Discovery notes (call 2026-02-24):
- Wants hosted API to avoid ops overhead. "self-serve, fast onboarding" emphasized by CTO.
- Primary stack: Node.js backend, Postgres for metadata, evaluating Pinecone / Weaviate for vector storage.
- Target latency: 200-400ms for top-k rerank path (user-facing). Throughput: 5-10 qps initially, seasonal spikes to ~40 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: fairly high; aim to keep embedding + rerank cost under $0.02/query at scale.
- Model preferences: open models OK, prefer clarity on tokenized cost and response streaming. Asked about Redwood verified models.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for admin operations. No on-prem requirement right now.

SE deep-dive (2026-03-04):
- Walked through embedding pipeline: embed -> upsert to vector DB -> search (ANN) -> fetch candidates -> rerank via Redwood hosted generation API. Discussed local reranker vs. API-based rerank (we recommended starting with hosted rerank for speed of iteration).
- Connector questions: wants a sample integration for Pinecone and open-source Weaviate; asked if Redwood has code snippets or SDK helpers for common vector stores. Action: SE to send sample repo + SDK snippet (Ravi).
- Rate limits: asked about per-minute and concurrent streaming limits for Hosted API and how that plays with bursty traffic. Also wants guidance for batching embeddings to save costs.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We want something we can plug in this week and not manage infra for months." - Head of Product
- "If we can hit 200-400ms for UX, shipping search is a go." - CTO

Next steps (short):
- Send Node.js example repo for embed + vector DB upsert + rerank (Ravi) — target 2026-03-12.
- Customer to sign up for self-serve credits; run smoke test with 10k docs.
- Follow-up workshop: 45min session to run sample dataset and measure end-to-end latency.

Blockers: budget approval from CFO (tentative), final decision on vector DB (Pinecone preferred by infra lead), need clarity on rate limits for spikes.
